title: Kevin O'Connell on Jamal Adams: Crushed for him, we're going to miss him

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kevin O'Connell on Jamal Adams: Crushed for him, we're going to miss him
sources.description: The Vikings have not given an official update on the nature of the injury that caused linebacker/safety Jamal Adams to be carted off in the first half of Saturday's game against the Giants, but it does not sound like he's going to be making it back on the field anytime soon.
